scores.evidence: The s3-diagram flowchart TD fits 390 px and its Japanese labels are readable (pages/mobile-jp-09.png). The three 2-column tables (s2-table, s3-table, s4-table) wrap cleanly with no overflow (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, 10.png, 12-13.png). One code line in pr-code is cut off at 390 px, right in the middle of the filename CLAUDE.md (pages/mobile-jp-22.png).

textOnlyScreens is empty on desktop and mobile. Every screen has a heading, table, figure, code, steps or a check, and there are no walls of text or empty gaps. Desktop JP charsPerLine median is 39 (target 30-40).

All text and diagram labels are Japanese, English is given on first use (e.g. kitchen sink session), contrast is fine and no controls are hidden under the bars. The narrow table columns and the long inline code in objective o1 cause some breaks inside words on mobile, such as セッショ/ン and 見分/け (pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-01.png).

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the line echo '- <title>は「練習：」で始める' > CLAUDE.md is cut off at 'CLAUDE.m'. The final 'd' is hidden. pr-start tells learners to type the commands line by line, so anyone copying what they see creates CLAUDE.m and the exercise silently fails because the rules file is never loaded.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the line so it fits about 38 monospace columns. For example, write the rule as echo '- titleは「練習：」から' > CLAUDE.md, and change pr-prompt-a, pr-prompt-b and pr-answer to match. Another option is to also name the file in pr-start md: 「ファイル名は CLAUDE.md です」.

niceToHave: s4-table: on mobile the first column is narrow, so words break mid-word (セッショ/ン, 関/係, 読み続/ける). Shorter bold labels, or moving the English names into the second line, would help (pages/mobile-jp-12.png, pages/mobile-jp-13.png).
s2-table: the row 自動のコンテキスト圧縮 breaks 消/し on mobile. Shortening the cell (e.g. 「上限が近いと古い出力から消し、要約する」) would avoid it (pages/mobile-jp-06.png).

Objective o1: the unbreakable /clear・/compact・サブエージェント run forces 見分/け onto two lines on mobile in the objectives box and in ふりかえり (pages/mobile-jp-01.png, pages/mobile-jp-33.png). Putting spaces or 「、」 between the three tools would let the line break naturally.
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson, and the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px. Both are known draft-preview behaviour.
summary: metrics.json has no hard failures and the lessonHash matches sha256:e51506cc1e6117ed. The layout is clean and visually varied: the vertical compaction diagram, tables and prompt blocks all read well at 390 px, and there are no text-only screens or privacy issues. One must-fix: in pr-code, the echo line is cut off at 'CLAUDE.m' on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-22.png), so learners typing it would create the wrong file. Shorten that line.
